_comment: Ratchet for Tools/coverage_gate.py: the in-scope total and each layer may not drop more than `tolerance` points below these values. The macOS test runs are not deterministic (layers measured up to 0.9pp apart on identical code), so raise only the layers a change actually moved, from the lower of two runs; `coverage_gate.py --write-floor` never lowers a value. Never lower a floor to make a PR pass. `null` means not measured yet (bootstrap: the gate reports, and passes).
